name: Shanrigol Mound
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-14: The Tomb Between Worlds

generalAbilities.name: Necrotic Decay
generalAbilities.description: When the shanrigol mound dies, its flesh rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a 5ft Emanation around the body. This gas deals 4d6 Void Damage damage to creatures in this area as their flesh curdles and rots as well (Basic DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: All-Around Vision
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster can see in all directions simultaneously and therefore can't be flanked.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sapping Squeeze
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The shanrigol has a creature grabbed

Effect The shanrigol squeezes the life essence from its target, dealing (1d6+8) Bludgeoning Damage]{1d6+8 bludgeoning and 1d4 persistent bleed damage} (Basic DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw save).

The shanrigol regains temporary Hit Points equal to half the amount of bludgeoning damage a single target takes; these temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shred Flesh
offensiveAbilities.description: A shanrigol rips flesh away from targets in great chunks. Creatures critically hit by the shanrigol's fleshy slap Strike take an additional 1d6 Bleed Damage and are Enfeebled 1 for as long as they are bleeding.

offensiveAbilities.name: Undulating Step
offensiveAbilities.description: The shanrigol separates its flesh from its bones to fit through small spaces. It Strides, ignoring difficult terrain and fitting through tight spaces as though it were a Tiny creature. It can't use any actions other than Undulating Step until it occupies an area large enough for its normal form.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
